name: Christian Street YMCA Summer Camp
description_short: Greater Philadelphia YMCA day camp at the Christian Street YMCA in South Philadelphia, booked a week at a time, serving Southwest Center City, Graduate Hospital, Point Breeze and nearby. Traditional camp follows weekly themes with STEM, crafts, swim or water play, team building, games and a field trip or in-house experience. Care from 7 am to 6 pm is included.
refund_policy_summary: Deposits are non-refundable and can move between weeks until May 15. Cancellations or changes need 15 business days' notice before the camp week; after that the whole week's fee is non-refundable. No credit for missed days or weather closures.
notes: Before care from 7 am and after care to 6 pm are included in the price. Ages, dates and prices are in a planner marked 'Coming Soon'. Campers bring lunch and two snacks.
